chunks.en: the rules that governs you. So the job of the social scientists is to study what are these rules that governs all of us. How do you study? You study it because, as I said, these social facts are real. It's important to understand this concept before you can understand the Kant's theory of religion. This social fact, they are real and they are outside you. You can't study it because I'm studying you. And so in order to get at the outside, I need to go in this side.
chunks.zh: 支配你的规则。因此，社会科学家的工作就是研究这些支配我们所有人的规则是什么。你怎么研究呢？你研究它，因为正如我所说，这些社会事实是真实的。在你理解康德的宗教理论之前，理解这个概念很重要。这些社会事实是真实的，它们存在于你之外。你不能通过研究你本人来研究它们。因此，为了接触到外部，我需要从内部入手。

chunks.en: I need to study you as a religion. Because each and every one of you internalizes the norm of social science. So Peter Berger, I teach another module of Asian science. We spend a lot of time on this. I wouldn't spend much time on this. But the Peter Berger's argument is that men or women, men live in a society. You all exist in a society. In fact, you all don't exist as... Remember why I think one of the first points I made at the beginning of this class
chunks.zh: 我需要像研究宗教一样研究你们。因为你们每个人都内化了社会科学的规范。所以彼得·伯杰，我教授另一个亚洲科学的模块。我们在这上面花了很多时间。我原本不会花很多时间在这上面。但彼得·伯杰的论点是，男人或女人，男人生活在社会中。你们所有人都存在于社会中。事实上，你们都不单独存在……记住我为什么认为我在这门课开始时提出的第一个观点之一

chunks.en: was the physical impossibility of being a hermit. Physical impossibility of being a hermit. Why? Because there is no you except the social you. That's what Durkheim argued. The physical, you can never be a hermit. Because everything you do is in free language. Language is social, right? And so men lives in society, but society lives in men. Peter Berger's famous book, Social Construction of Reality. Men in Society and Society in Men. Go Google this phrase,
chunks.zh: 成为隐士的身体上的不可能性。成为隐士的身体上的不可能性。为什么？因为除了社会化的你之外，没有真正的你。这就是杜尔凯姆所论证的。物理上的你，永远无法成为隐士。因为你所做的一切都是用自由语言进行的。语言是社会性的，对吧？所以人生活在社会中，但社会也存在于人之中。彼得·伯杰著名的书《现实的社会建构》。人存在于社会中，社会存在于人之中。去谷歌这个短语,

chunks.en: because I think it's an important concept. If you want to understand that kind, men in society, society in men. Now, if you take that framework, then what is the thing that all of you conform to? I mean, there are deviant people, there are people who break laws, but they are deviant, that's why they are punished, right? But all of you basically conform to rules. Why do you conform to rules? Society regulates your behavior. So the most important question to ask then
chunks.zh: 因为我认为这是一个重要的概念。如果你想理解那种类型的男性在社会中的角色，社会在男性中的作用。现在，如果你采用那个框架，那么你们所有人遵守的是什么呢？我的意思是，有偏离常规的人，也有违法的人，但他们是偏离常规的，所以他们会受到惩罚，对吧？但你们所有人基本上都遵守规则。你们为什么遵守规则？社会规范了你们的行为。所以最重要的问题是要问

chunks.en: from this approach is how does society governs your behavior? And Durkheim's answer is society governs your behavior by using religion. Religion provides the moral, the ethical, and the social basis for society to constrain you. Let me repeat this phrase. Religion provides the moral system. You must not murder. Ethical system. It is wrong to steal. And the social system. You live with each other. So the question shifts. The question shifts from why people have religion,
chunks.zh: 从这种方法来看，问题是社会如何规范你的行为？杜尔凯姆的答案是社会通过宗教来规范你的行为。宗教为社会约束你提供了道德、伦理和社会基础。让我重复一下这句话。宗教提供道德体系。你不能杀人。伦理体系。偷窃是错误的。以及社会体系。你与他人共同生活。所以问题发生了转变。问题从为什么人们有宗教转变为

chunks.en: what does religion do? We are not individuals. We're never individuals. Because at no point are you an individual. You are constantly being constrained by society. When I began this class, and I will just repeat this, I began this class by saying but all of you think you behave individually. All of you think you have free will. All of you think you make choices. Some of you decided to come to class today. Some of you decided you will not come to class today.
chunks.zh: 宗教起什么作用？我们不是个体。我们从来不是个体。因为你在任何时候都不是个体。你不断受到社会的约束。当我开始这门课时，我会重复一遍，我开始这门课时说，但你们所有人都认为自己是个体行为的。你们所有人都认为自己有自由意志。你们所有人都认为自己能做出选择。你们中有些人决定今天来上课。你们中有些人决定今天不来上课。

chunks.en: You think you have free will. But Durkheim argued there is no such thing. Society always constrains you. I use the example of the movie,
chunks.zh: 你认为你有自由意志。但杜尔凯姆认为根本不存在这种东西。社会总是约束你。我举电影的例子，

chunks.en: It's good, but it's not the one. It's the other one. The Matrix. I mentioned who has watched The Matrix. Number three is the best movie. Number one is good. Number two is terrible. You don't agree. What is a fundamental idea in The Matrix? It's a very simple idea. The idea is that human beings exist but we don't actually exist. It exists as part of a computer program. All of you are holograms. And there are scientists today who can't really believe that that is true.
chunks.zh: 很好，但那不是正确的。是另一个。黑客帝国。我提到过谁看过《黑客帝国》。第三部是最好的电影。第一部很好。第二部很糟糕。你不同意。《黑客帝国》的一个基本理念是什么？这是一个非常简单的理念。理念是人类存在，但我们实际上并不存在。我们存在于计算机程序中。你们都是全息图。今天有一些科学家实际上无法相信这是真的。

chunks.en: No, not film. All of you are actually holograms. What a hologram is? Some advanced culture, thousands of thousands of years in the future have created a computer program which created you. So you don't actually exist. You are part of the holograms. The idea of The Matrix is that you all think you exist. However, there is actually a supercomputer somewhere that created you as holograms as if you really exist. And you live your life as if you really exist
chunks.zh: 不，不是电影。你们所有人实际上都是全息影像。什么是全息影像？某个先进的文明，几千几万年后的未来，创造了一个计算机程序，这个程序创造了你们。所以你们实际上并不存在。你们是全息影像的一部分。《黑客帝国》的理念是，你们都认为自己存在。然而，实际上在某个地方有一台超级计算机，它创造了你们作为全息影像，就好像你们真的存在一样。而你们也按照真的存在的方式生活着。

chunks.en: but everything is already designed by a supercomputer. And if you know The Matrix, each has a different idea of what is humanity. The first idea is humans are naturally good. Perfect. And the world cannot exist. That's why you crash it. Then the second model is that human beings are fundamentally bad and created another matrix. And it also crashed. We came to The Matrix 3. But the idea is simple. What is a supercomputer? Actually it's a wonderful analogy to their kind.
chunks.zh: 但是一切已经由超级计算机设计好了。如果你了解《黑客帝国》，每个人对人类都有不同的看法。第一个观点认为人类本性是善良的。完美。但是世界无法存在。这就是你为什么会崩溃它。第二个模型认为人类本质上是邪恶的，因此创建了另一个矩阵。它也崩溃了。于是我们来到了《黑客帝国3》。但想法很简单。什么是超级计算机？实际上，这是对它们种类的一个奇妙比喻。

chunks.en: The supercomputer is society. The you is the hologram in that society. And so all of us are within a superstructure of society. If religion functions to society together, then what is religion? So we have gone through this. I won't spend too much time on this. Religion is a unified system of belief and practices relative to sacred things. That is things that are set apart and forbidden belief and practices united in a single model of community called a church
chunks.zh: 超级计算机就是社会。你是那个社会中的全息影像。因此，我们所有人都处于社会的一个超级结构之中。如果宗教的功能是将社会聚合在一起，那么宗教是什么呢？所以我们已经讨论过这个问题。我不会在这上面花太多时间。宗教是一套关于神圣事物的统一信仰和实践体系。神圣事物是那些被特别划分和禁止的事物，信仰和实践在一个被称为教会的共同体模型中结合在一起。

chunks.en: and to all those who adhere to religion. Unlike Tyler who sees religion as a mistake or unlike Freud who sees religion as an illusion, the concept religion is neither a mistake nor an illusion. Religion is a central idea in society. It is the basic idea of the human nature. It is the basic premise for social order in society. Religion is not false. Religion is part of the social process of society. In this definition, as I said, we always look at dichotomy.
chunks.zh: 对于所有信仰宗教的人。不同于将宗教视为错误的泰勒，也不同于将宗教视为幻想的弗洛伊德，宗教的概念既不是错误，也不是幻想。宗教是社会的核心理念。它是人类本性的基本观念。它是社会秩序的基本前提。宗教不虚假。宗教是社会社会过程中不可或缺的一部分。在这个定义中，正如我所说，我们总是看二分法。

chunks.en: When you study religion, as I mentioned from the first class, we always look for the dualities. The dualities between a material and a non-material. The duality between a physical body and a non-physical body. There is always a duality.
chunks.zh: 当你学习宗教时，正如我在第一堂课上提到的，我们总是在寻找二元对立。物质与非物质之间的二元对立。身体与非物理身体之间的二元对立。总是存在二元对立。
